checkpoint.name: Alpha 2.0 - Grass Toucher class path
checkpoint.summary: Fixed mobile class picker readability, added Grass Toucher class-only skills and quests, verified locally, pushed, and deployed production.

changes: Changed narrow class picker cards to compact readable rows instead of vertically crushed desktop cards.
Kept desktop class picker layout visually unchanged.
Added Grass Toucher-only Honest Work skill.
Added Grass Toucher-only Patient Observation skill.
Reused existing skill icon assets to avoid new asset requirements.
Added Grass Toucher class quests An Honest Afternoon and Knows The Lawn.
Class branch helper now recognizes the new Grass Toucher skill nodes.
Grass Toucher class quest claim feedback uses a green burst.

checks: Mobile class picker at 390x844 is readable.
Desktop class picker at 1280x720 still fits three cards.
Grass Toucher starts and HUD shows Grass Toucher - Honest Touch.
Skill tree renders the new Grass Toucher nodes with no missing asset errors.
Class quest filter shows the two Grass Toucher quests.
Stress/perf smoke at ?stress&perf&tiles=120 had no console errors.

knownCaveats: The new class skills are intentionally modest and may need real playtest tuning.
Skill tree is visually dense in maxed stress mode; new nodes are usable but future tree layout cleanup would help.
Mobile title art still crops horizontally by design from the existing title-screen behavior.
recommendedNextSteps: Start the first automation slice from the clean Grass Toucher class path checkpoint.
Prefer extending existing SprinklerSystem or adding a small Watering Can system before larger offline progress.
After any automation change, run npm run build and smoke test ?stress&perf&tiles=120.
Keep automation from building manual combo/rhythm unless explicitly requested later.
